limitations: only the file:line kind is truth-checked; migration and bare git-show keep block-level presence, with the ceiling printed by the CLI
the check verifies a cited line holds the quoted text, not that the text supports the claim drawn from it (iter-1 LD-3 demonstrated the gap)
pairing is scoped to the whole Locked-Decisions region, not per-LD
working-tree evidence is checked at lint time, not as of authoring
non_goals: per-LD pairing granularity: LDs are bold spans not headings, so narrowing needs an authoring-convention change across every existing plan
promoting the lint to a binding VETO
changing check_plan's module-path and skill-path warnings
exclusions: main() keeps writing to sys.stderr; iter-1 wrongly said stdout

open_questions: Does the span-based exclusion mask a legitimate prose citation? Resolved by test_a_prose_citation_is_still_checked_when_the_same_path_appears_in_a_statement.
Does reason wording constrain the implementation? Yes - the existing suite asserts 'evidence' in reason.lower(); all three kinds must retain it.
